value: HDI, compared with control subjects, demonstrated significantly decreased GM volume in the bilateral medial PFC, bilateral DLPFC, and right fusiform cortex.
The GM volumes in the bilateral medial PFC, bilateral DLPFC, and right fusiform cortex were reduced in HDIs.

The reduced prefrontal GM volume was negatively correlated with impulsivity scores and duration of heroin use, suggesting that greater prefrontal volume loss was associated with greater impulsivity and longer heroin use.
